CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated list of hardware feature codes that MUST be present for this product to be eligible. Used in hardware-first workflow to filter products based on hardware feature codes. Leave blank if no specific feature codes required. Example: "FC001;FC002;FC003"
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Semicolon-separated feature codes required for eligibility (e.g., "FC001;FC002"). Product is eligible only if hardware has ALL listed feature codes.
CustomField.label: Required Feature Codes
